g.text: Top → middle: fitted period / preprocessing changes. Middle → bottom: three-month averaging only.
Month of development year (13 = January of following year)
Old fit: 2002–2024; new fit: 1982–2024. Same D20 state, seasonal sLIM estimator, February–June starts, and 1991–2020 reference.
Three-month forecast centers use leads 1–8 (valid windows only); monthly forecasts include lead 0–9. No new parameter fitting in this audit.
